description: This source file defines the 'Gdpr' class within the OpenCart framework. It handles GDPR-related actions such as displaying the GDPR information page, processing GDPR requests (like data export or removal), and displaying success pages. The class extends the core Controller class and interacts with models such as 'catalog/information' and 'account/gdpr' to manage GDPR compliance functionalities.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Main controller class managing GDPR-related pages and actions such as displaying GDPR info, processing user GDPR requests (export/removal), and showing success/error pages.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the GDPR information page if it exists, setting up breadcrumbs and page data.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Processes GDPR requests submitted via POST, such as exporting or removing user data. Validates input, interacts with models, and returns JSON responses.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Displays a success page after GDPR data processing, or a not-found page if invalid code supplied.
